decisions.reason: The trial replacement makes the trial-specific source and topic constraints obsolete, but the existing message-19 MODIFY already removes both applicable attributes completely.
The trial-specific hook criterion is affected, but the existing message-19 MODIFY already removes the only applicable attribute.
The replacement of the clip trial affects the assigned trial batch, but the existing message-19 events already remove both batch attributes and defer the requirement.
The clean-editing criterion was scoped to the discontinued trial clips, but the existing message-19 MODIFY already removes its sole attribute.
